title: Foil-Baked Salmon with White Wine and Oregano
blurb: Salmon steaks baked in foil parcels with white wine, oregano and spring onions. The fish stays moist and picks up the herb flavours as it steams.
steps: Heat your oven to 200°C and tear off two large squares of foil.
Finely chop the spring onions and divide them between the foil squares, making a small bed in the centre of each.
Place a salmon steak on each bed of spring onions, then drizzle with the olive oil and white wine.
Sprinkle the oregano, salt and pepper over the salmon steaks.
Fold the foil over each salmon steak and crimp the edges to seal the parcels completely.
Place the parcels on a baking tray and bake for 10 minutes until the salmon is just cooked through.
Carefully open the parcels and serve the salmon with the cooking juices spooned over.
